timeline.event: Multiple people are present in or near the lab.
Professor Rao is last seen alive in the staged footage.
The incident occurs in the fictional story; image enhancement reveals a staged clock overlay, not a verified time of death.
Kabir removes the prototype using Aarav's backpack, according to the case file and staged corridor sequence.
The fictional surveillance corruption script executes.

evidence.title: Clock crop: 23:42
evidence.description: The enhanced prepared CCTV overlay reads 23:42.
evidence.method: CLAHE on a synthetic staged still
evidence.limitations: A staged timestamp is not independent proof of time of death.

evidence.title: Scene comparison
evidence.description: Prepared reference shows an extra cup; mobile phone and prototype are represented by explicit scene inventory comparison, not generic detector claims.
evidence.method: Scene inventory comparison; YOLO is optional
evidence.expected: Additional cup in later scene; phone and prototype absent from the prepared inventory.
evidence.limitations: COCO detector may miss small objects and cannot identify the fictional prototype.

evidence.title: Backpack ownership record
evidence.description: Aarav's case-file statement identifies him as owner; the color detector only finds red regions.
evidence.limitations: Color segmentation cannot determine identity or ownership.

evidence.title: Exit-line trail
evidence.description: Actual color segmentation tracks a synthetic red candidate across the defined exit line.
evidence.method: HSV mask, contours, recent-centre trail and line crossing
evidence.expected: Observed candidate crosses line near frame 56; case file identifies Kabir as carrier.
evidence.limitations: The generated silhouette is synthetic; tracking alone does not identify the carrier.

evidence.title: ARGUS system log
evidence.description: Prepared fictional log records the corruption-script event.
evidence.limitations: This log is a prepared narrative artifact, not recovered by image processing.
